meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (Offshore Special Territory under Crown sovereignty)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None in force as a standalone bilateral investment treaty for Gibraltar; UK-Gibraltar Tax Cooperation Arrangement 2019 applies.
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance extended to Gibraltar for tax cooperation and information exchange.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Gibraltar Proceeds of Crime Act 2015; Gibraltar AML/CFT Regulations 2019; Companies Act 2014; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017 (Gibraltar); Bermuda Exempted Companies Act 1981 (as the source legal form); Financial Services Act 2019 (Gibraltar).

Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized passport copies and proof of residential address for all UBOs and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence of each signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if origin is a Hague member; otherwise consular legalization at UK/Gibraltar diplomatic post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Office Consent and Company Secretary Consent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private notarization; no apostille required for Gibraltar domestic document

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council sanctions, EU consolidated list, HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list, and Interpol notices. Enhanced due diligence applies automatically to any PEP-linked individual; source of wealth documentation and senior management approval are required. Suspicious activity must be reported to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit within 24 hours under the AML/CFT Regulations 2019.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry (Companies House Gibraltar) via the Government of Gibraltar portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be expressed in English or in Roman characters. Non-English names require a verified transliteration into the Roman alphabet. No additional local-script translation is required for Gibraltar incorporation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Companies Registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative objection with the Registrar of Companies within 21 days. The objection must cite the Companies Act 2014 provisions on misleading names and submit revised evidence of statutory compliance. If the objection is denied, the applicant may appeal by way of an originating application to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar under the Civil Procedure Rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is accepted through a licensed Gibraltar corporate service provider, provided a physical registered office address in Gibraltar is maintained for service of process. The VPN/privacy SaaS industry is not a licensable activity; therefore no local staff or minimum substance is mandatory at the stage 1 clearance phase.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate (estimated 20%). The Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit, Companies Registry, and Revenue may conduct risk-based AML/CFT inspections. Unannounced on-site inspection is unlikely for a non-licensed SaaS entity unless inconsistent AML records or adverse sanctions screening flags arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 2014 (Gibraltar), as amended — ss. 12-22 (incorporation), s. 55 (registered office), Part IV (share capital and securities); Income Tax Act 2010, s. 8 (non-residence from tax for non-Gibraltar managed and controlled companies, functional analog of the Bermuda Exempted Company exemption); Companies (Fees) Regulations 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Registrar of Companies (Corporate Registry Division, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission), HM Government of Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 — Application for Registration as a Company, supported by notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association and Form 2 — Statutory Declaration of Compliance
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow/deposit requirement for this private company limited by shares (non-resident 'exempted company' structure under Gibraltar law). Nominal capital is set in the Memorandum (commonly one ordinary share of USD 1.00); allotments are recorded in the Register of Members and no capital has to be economically deposited in Gibraltar for formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PASSED IN WRITING PURSUANT TO THE ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION.

1. RESOLVED that, upon issue of the Certificate of Incorporation, the subscription shares be allotted to the initial shareholder at par, fully paid, and entered in the Register of Members forthwith.

2. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the licensed registered-office address in Gibraltar named in the incorporation filing, where all statutory correspondence may be lawfully served.

3. RESOLVED that the persons named in the consent forms be appointed first Director and Secretary, each holding office until retirement or removal by ordinary resolution, and that such officers are authorized to open bank accounts and to transact all business of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation, AML Pre-Clearance and Registered Office Keeper Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House eServices portal (Corporate Registry Division, GFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Reserve the proposed company name online via the GFSC eServices portal through a licensed corporate service provider (CSP). Complete the customer due-diligence (CDD) file for each proposed shareholder and officer, with enhanced checks given the Medium_Risk_Enhanced rating of the VPN/privacy software business, and execute the CSP engagement letter that appoints the registered-office keeper. The reserved name is valid for 28 days from the reservation notice.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (online)
Company name availability search confirmation
Certified copies of passports of all shareholders, directors and secretary
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement within 3 months)
AML/CDD questionnaire including source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statements
Licensed CSP engagement and registered-office keeper letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict, obscenity or ministerial objection, file a fresh reservation with up to three alternative names; where refusal rests on similarity with an existing trader, submit a signed letter of non-objection from that entity. The reservation window can be renewed once before expiry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, Execution and Notarization of the Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Gibraltar Notary Public, in coordination with the appointed CSP
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association containing the exempted-company variant provisions (non-resident ownership unrestricted, no Gibraltar management and control, fully unlocked share clauses, wide corporate objects covering ISIC 6201 software and encryption services). Have the subscriber and the first directors execute the documents before a Gibraltar notary; remote subscribers may use electronic signature with notarial e-verification in accordance with the Electronic Commerce Act 2001.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (executed)
Articles of Association (executed)
Subscriber statement / Form of Subscription
Consent to act as Director and Consent to act as Secretary
Notary commissioning instruction and completion certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notarial requisitions or defective subscriber details are cured by executing a replacement page or superseding declaration and re-notarization; no new name reservation is required where only clerical particulars are corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form 1 and Payment of the Registry Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies House (GFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the CSP trusted agent, submit Form 1 (Application for Registration as a Company) with the notarized M&A and Form 2 (Statutory Declaration of Compliance) attached, and pay the incorporation fee online by card or bank transfer. Select standard registration (three working days) or same-day expedited registration; the filing time is recorded by the registry portal. No notarized apostille is needed as the filing is purely domestic.
required_dossiers: Form 1 — Application for Registration as a Company
Form 2 — Statutory Declaration of Compliance
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of Registered Office (Form 7)
Registry fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition, the incorporator may rectify the defective document electronically within 14 days without additional filing fees. Where the reservation has lapsed or the regime stance changes, a fresh Form 1 can be submitted against the same draft structure with the Director's initial written authority, preserving the company number only if the requisition is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Seal and Statutory Registers Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Registrar of Companies (GFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the electronic Certificate of Incorporation, cause the company seal and share certificates to be prepared, and open the statutory registers (Register of Members, Register of Directors and Secretary, Register of Charges and Register of Beneficial Owners / ROBO obligation) at the registered office; file the register-location notice where the registers are to be kept outside the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Company common seal (minuted adoption)
Register of Members and share certificates
Register of Directors and Secretary
Register of Charges
Register of Beneficial Owners (ROBO) initial entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors in the Certificate or registers are corrected by a Form CORR submission with the Registrar's formal consent; where a share certificate is lost or defaced, replace it after board authority and indemnity, with a correction file kept for audit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax File Number and Non-Resident Exempted Status Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, HM Government of Gibraltar (Income Tax Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Gibraltar tax file number and file the Declaration of Non-Residence establishing that central management and control (CMC) is situated outside Gibraltar; because CMC is offshore, the company is outside the charge to Gibraltar income tax, reproducing the Bermuda Exempted Company outcome. The declaration is accompanied by the first board minutes recording offshore management and by shareholder residence certificates.
required_dossiers: Application for tax file number (Form TFN)
Declaration of central management and control outside Gibraltar
Certificate of Incorporation and M&A
Board minutes confirming offshore decision-making
Residence evidence of shareholder(s) and directors
Opening balance sheet / nil accounts draft
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Commissioner queries the residence conclusion, submit supplementary proof of offshore management (board packs, decision logs, director travel records) and, upon adverse assessment, file an appeal to the Board of Review under the Income Tax Act 2010 within 30 days of the notice.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Financial Services Commission of Gibraltar (GFSC), acting as the post-Brexit monetary and financial-services regulator, in coordination with HM Treasury (United Kingdom), which retains residual sovereign authority over the Gibraltar pound and exchange-control matters.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is pegged at a fixed 1:1 exchange rate with GBP Sterling. Gibraltar applies full current-account and capital-account convertibility; there are no exchange-control approvals, queues, or quantitative restrictions on dividend/profit remittances, capital returns, shareholder loans, or trade payments. Profit and capital outflows are subject only to standard AML/KYC documentary source-of-funds verification and tax status confirmation. Because GIP is not separately floated, FX convertibility risk is effectively identical to that of GBP.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory proceeds-surrender requirement applies in Gibraltar. Export receipts, service fees, licensing royalties, and SaaS subscription proceeds may be retained indefinitely in any permitted foreign currency. The statutory conversion timeline is N/A and the mandatory conversion ratio is 0%. All export proceeds must be received through a licensed bank, recorded in the company books with the relevant invoice reference, and made available for AML/CFT audit inspection.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium-High for operational receipts and Low for capital preservation. A Gibraltar-licensed Electronic Money Institution is viable after obtaining the required e-money and payment-institution authorisation from GFSC; it can handle merchant settlement flows from Stripe/Paymentwall and operational vendor disbursements. Offshore EMIs domiciled in zero-tax non-EEA hubs are legally usable only as payment processors, not as account-holding or escrow institutions, and cannot lawfully safeguard client funds or hold capital injections for a Gibraltar-regulated treasury structure. Critical constraint: EMIs cannot execute FX hedging, issue Commercial Letters of Credit, or hold shareholder capital escrow balances; these functions are reserved for licensed credit institutions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by at least one director, together with the designated AML/KYC compliance officer if applicable, at the chosen bank's Gibraltar office is mandatory for this medium-risk-enhanced classification. Remote opening is accepted only where the bank already has an established group relationship of at least 12 months with the Bermuda parent, or where a qualified Gibraltar advocate/notary conducts an in-person verification meeting and certifies all signatures, passport copies, and original certificates. Pure video-only onboarding will not satisfy the enhanced due diligence expectations for a non-resident exempted company engaged in internet-privacy and VPN technology.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Anonymous or opaque ownership structure of a Bermuda Exempted Company, potentially indicating bearer shares, nominee shareholders, or undisclosed UBOs.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bermuda Registrar's Certificate of Good Standing; notarised Certificate of Incumbency; register of members showing natural-person or listed-entity ownership; corporate organisation chart with full UBO disclosure; FATCA/CRS self-certifications; sworn affidavit from directors that no bearer shares are issued and that all beneficial owners are identified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: VPN and network-privacy business flagged as medium-risk enhanced due to possible anonymity abuse, crypto-payment exposure, or dual-use network evasion concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent AML programme prepared by a GFSC-recognised compliance consultant; transaction monitoring and system-monitoring policy; prohibition of cash and crypto payments; merchant acquirer (Stripe/Paymentwall) underwriting approval letters; public terms of service and acceptable-use policy; audited financial statements by an ICAEW-recognised auditor; live IP-geolocation and customer business records for commercial accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of economic substance in Gibraltar and non-resident corporate governance structure, raising shell-company or brass-plate risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Gibraltar substance file: physical office lease or serviced-office arrangement; local payroll records; bank mandate granting authority to local licensed authorised signatory; board minutes and decision log confirming Gibraltar oversight; annual accounts filed with the Gibraltar Companies Registry; annual return and tax status filing confirming exempted/non-resident treatment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Financial-sanctions, corruption, or adverse-media exposure caused by cross-border sales in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: World-Check/Refinitiv enhanced screening reports for all directors, shareholders, and material counterparties; negative-media sign-off; source-of-funds verification with sworn bank statements from the Bermuda entity; legal opinion from a Bermuda law firm on the exempted company's good standing; sanctions exclusions in the customer terms of service; enhanced due diligence questionnaire completed by intermediate distributors.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Routing for share-capital and shareholder loans flows from the Bermuda parent operating account into the Gibraltar capital-escrow account via SWIFT MT103 (for standard transfers) or MT202 COV (for high-value cover payments above GBP 50,000). The remitting bank must include structured payment-purpose code 'DINV' for direct investment or 'EQUI' for equity-linked subscription, and the free-text Description field must contain 'CAPITAL INJECTION / SUBSCRIPTION / CONTRIBUTION — <LEGAL ENTITY NAME>'. The receiving Gibraltar bank must match the beneficiary name exactly, obtain the specific capital-account reference, and require the same-day remitter confirmation of the real economic purpose. Wire verification is completed by isometric reconciliation of the cover message, the Beneficiary Bank statement, and the company's capital-account ledger entry.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail for recurring SaaS/network vendor payments (colocation, bandwidth, encryption licences, cloud infrastructure) is SWIFT MT103 with invoice and purchase-order references attached. For procurement contracts or infrastructure hardware commitments above USD 250,000, the Gibraltar credit institution may issue an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit pursuant to UCP600, with confirmation in the vendor's jurisdiction if required. Presentation documents include pro-forma invoice, transport document (AWB or Bill of Lading if physical hardware), inspection certificate, original insurance certificate, and final beneficiary certification. For GBP or EUR disbursements to UK/EU suppliers, Faster Payments/CHAPS or SEPA may be used where the relevant correspondent bank supports such rails, but all payments must retain full audit trail and be recorded on the books as trade or operating expenses.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards between GIP/GBP and USD/EUR with maturities up to 12 months, fully documented as genuine exposure hedges
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for invoicing currencies subject to official exchange-rate restrictions recognised by the Gibraltar bank's risk committee
Cross-currency swaps (USD/GBP and EUR/GBP) matched to underlying capital-escrow assets or financed trade receivables
Vanilla European-exercise FX options for covered commercial contract premiums
Listed FX futures executed through a Gibraltar-licensed investment firm, provided they are used solely for macroeconomic exposure hedging

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Exempted Company Annual Return (form AR, Companies Act 1981, s.79)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; if no change, still file a nil return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default penalty of BMD 50 per day up to BMD 2,000; two consecutive years of non-filing allows the Registrar to dissolve the company by administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bermuda Annual Government Fee for Exempted Company (annual fee assessment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (on behalf of Bermuda Government)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary of incorporation and covers the next twelve months; payable together with the annual return.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a 10% surcharge and loss of good-standing; continued default for 18 months permits strike-off and, after 3 years, disclaimer of assets to the Crown.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (BO declaration filed with the annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the annual return (30 days post incorporation anniversary) irrespective of whether a change of ownership has occurred.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Offence punishable by fine of BMD 5,000 plus continuing penalty of BMD 250 per day; officers may be personally liable.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Gibraltar Overseas Company Annual Branch Return (foreign company registration confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: If the Bermuda company maintains a place of business or branch in Gibraltar, file within 60 days after the anniversary of the branch's registration in Gibraltar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of GBP 200 per month to a maximum of GBP 1,200; failure to file may result in removal of the branch from the foreign companies register and a fine on the local representative.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory size-based audit threshold for a Bermuda Exempted Company. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only where the company is licensed under Bermuda's Banks and Deposit Companies Act, Insurance Act, or Investment Funds Act, or where a shareholder special resolution demands an audit; otherwise, unaudited financial statements may be adopted.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the default for regulated exempted companies; unregulated entities may adopt IFRS, US GAAP, or another accepted comprehensive basis (local GAAP), provided the chosen framework is applied consistently and disclosed in the financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: On every anniversary of incorporation, the Bermuda registered agent must verify the Register of Members against the current beneficial ownership data, record any transfer of registered shares or change in significant control, and cause the company to file the annual BO confirmation with the Bermuda Registrar. Share transfers are effective only after entry of the transferee's name in the Register of Members; the UBO declaration must identify each registrable beneficial owner with a determinable percentage. For the Gibraltar branch, the certified extract of the register of members must be delivered to the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies if a branch is maintained.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (including registered and non-resident shareholders)
Register of Secretaries (if any secretary is appointed)
Beneficial ownership register (under the Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2018)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Bermuda registered agent and office: USD 1,400 - 4,000 per year; Gibraltar branch registered office/fiduciary (if applicable): USD 500 - 2,000 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000 - 20,000 per financial year for a VPN/SaaS operating entity when a certified audit is required; no audit fee is mandatory in the absence of an audit trigger.
